added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite or after_suite gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: EXPECTED_PROMPTS pins ten prompts while §22 names twelve, so the positive control no longer fails if a call site is later added for signals/individualization or discovery/enricher; both are orphaned today and the node recorded them under follow_ons.

the field-presence assertion reads a field name anywhere in the rendered prompt, so deleting one field from a schema partial does not redden it (the node's first negative-control attempt passed, EXIT=0); only removing the whole render fails it, so the guard is coarser than the declared negative control states.
the prompt still carries a hand-written JSON example and no schema_needs although §22 names it; the node left it unchanged because it has no call site, so a live use would carry no generated schema.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against ecf996bf; four commits, 19 files, all inside the declared scope; no baseline arm is recorded.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names pytest tests/discovery tests/llm exiting 0 and a live TriageBatch check; the manifest records EXIT=0 (1425 passed, 9 skipped) and the live log records finish_reason stop and a validated TriageBatch of 40 results.
item_verdicts.goal: read §22 and the node goal; the landed change drops response_format from the dedicated local request builder at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:169 and rejects engine-aborted replies at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:1540 so a local structured call validates from the schema carried in its prompt, which is the goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command and its result, names the gate log, and records the landing plus the two orphan prompts under follow_ons.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path in the four commits lies inside them and no file outside them is touched.

justifications.durability: tests/discovery/test_llm_aborted_reply.py:98 fails when the abort branch is removed and test_llm_local_routing.py asserts the local request omits response_format, but test_prompt_schema_coverage.py only reddens when the whole schema render is removed, not on a single deleted field.
justifications.evidence: the gate pytest tests/discovery tests/llm is recorded EXIT=0 (1425 passed, 9 skipped) and the live check records prompt_tokens 99054 finish_reason stop and a validated TriageBatch; the manifest names no baseline_suite arm, so added failures are unmeasured rather than zero.
justifications.fit: the new _reject_unusable_reply helper at imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:1540 consolidates the four former ``if not content`` guards and the commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no plan or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:169 drops response_format from _local_call_kwargs and llm.py:1540 rejects finish_reason='abort' in all four structured loops, so a local structured call validates from the prompt-carried schema; the plan names twelve call-site prompts and ten are bound, the other two proven orphaned.
justifications.reuse: _reject_unusable_reply is the single owner of the empty/abort guard in llm.py and _provide_signal_source_unwind_schema follows the existing _SCHEMA_PROVIDERS pattern in prompt_loader.py rather than forking schema rendering.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path changed in the four commits lies inside the declared write paths, including the evidence fragment, README and the three test files.
